metadata.format: valid JSON; UTF-8; plain-text .txt file; no Markdown fences
metadata.line_count_requirement: The saved file itself must contain between 888 and 999 physical lines inclusive.
metadata.primary_execution_goal: Implement, test, document, and verify a complete working local-first software repository; do not merely describe how to build it.

project_brief.purpose: Build a secure, local-first decision-support application for tourism demand analysis, customer segmentation, revenue forecasting, and marketing-budget scenarios for the Lake Toba region.
project_brief.problem_statement: Tourism operators may have fragmented visitor, booking, seasonality, price, and campaign data; decisions are often made without traceable comparisons or uncertainty estimates.
core_workflows: Create or import a tourism dataset with provenance metadata.
Validate records and review data-quality warnings.
Explore visitor demand, bookings, revenue, seasonality, and customer segments.
Train and compare a lightweight demand forecast against a baseline.
Run budget and pricing scenarios with explicit assumptions.
Export a management report with recommendations and limitations.
